messages.subject: 3pl-MIRT(within-item)
parts:
Hi there,

Can this package deal with 3pl-MIRT(within-item especially)？I have read the manual but haven't been able to find details or examples about it.It seems that papers only introduce how to deal with between-item MIRT and Bfactor model etc.

Thanks.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: 3pl-MIRT(within-item)
parts:
Yes, just specify your model using the mirt.model() syntax. See the associated help file for details, and use the itemtype = '3PL' for each item you want modelled as a 3PL. 

Phil
